title: I advertise malicious software on Google Ads
summary: A security research article documenting how threat actors abuse Google Ads platform to advertise and distribute malicious software, providing insights into attack vectors and defensive countermeasures.
problem_solved: Documents how legitimate advertising platforms are weaponized by threat actors to distribute malware at scale.
why_valuable: Provides actionable threat intelligence about advertising-based attack patterns that help organizations improve their security posture and detection capabilities.
